title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-prep-2026-07-13
content:
Goal: 30-minute sync to align on high-priority infra work, console rollouts, and any regressions in the serving runtime. Keep to blocks: updates (10m), blockers + escalations (10m), action items and next steps (10m).

Context / background:
- Recent canary rollout of kernel-selection v2 landed on ded-dev; saw a 7-12% latency variance on long-context cases (seq_len > 2048).
- Console rollout (route-level tracing) scheduled for 2026-07-20; need final sign-off on dashboard thresholds and SLO docs.
- Autoscaling policy change for Dedicated pools (RINF-1298) awaiting infra validation; burst capacity test planned next week.

Agenda:
1) Quick rundowns (each person 1-2 min)
   - Priya: kernel-selection rollout metrics / APM highlights
   - Marco: Dedicated autoscale validation status and next test windows
   - Evelyn: Console tracing rollout readiness + outstanding UX items
2) Blockers / escalations (10 min)
   - Investigate latency variance on v2 kernels for long-context workloads (see RINF-1245)
   - Dedicated pool capacity: replication lag observed in gpu-update-3 after scale-down (ticket linked)
   - Console: missing sample traces on edge region (eu-west-3) for low-volume routes
3) Decisions needed / ask items (5 min)
   - Can we postpone full production rollout of kernel-selection v2 until after parity test with quantized models? (decision owner: Priya)
   - Confirm SLO thresholds for console tracing alerts (owner: Evelyn)
4) Action items recap (5 min)

Prep notes / data points to surface:
- Perf dashboards: 95th/99th latency delta pre/post v2 (link to PR above). Bring sample requests that reproduce the delta.
- Autoscale test plan: target burst to 1.5x baseline for 15m; monitoring: pod creation time, KV cache warmup latency, queue length.
- Console tracing: need one example request flow from eu-west-3 that fails to emit spans; gather raw logs from 2026-07-08 to 2026-07-12.

Quick talking points for each collaborator:
- Priya: bring a concise summary of the A/B perf test and flamegraphs; list of 3 hypothesized causes for latency variance.
- Marco: readiness checklist for Dedicated autoscale test; list of 2 rollback triggers.
- Evelyn: screenshots of the new route-level dashboard and proposed alert thresholds; note any UX items that are blocking sign-off.

Notes to self (Jordan):
- Ask infra to snapshot gpu-update-3 before next scale-down test (avoid losing repro logs).
- Remind Priya to clear the quantization parity test queue by Friday.
- Follow up with SRE on audit logs retention if console tracing is enabled by default.

Action items (tracking):
- "A1: Collect 6 sample requests that reproduce v2 latency spike and upload to /tmp/serving-repro (owner: Priya Raman) - due: 2026-07-14" ,
- "A2: Run Dedicated autoscale 1.5x burst test in staging, capture pod creation and KV warmup metrics (owner: Marco Alvarez) - due: 2026-07-16" ,
- "A3: Gather eu-west-3 raw logs for missing trace spans between 2026-07-08 and 2026-07-12 and attach to ticket (owner: Evelyn Chen) - due: 2026-07-14" ,
- "A4: Snapshot gpu-update-3 node before next scale-down (owner: Jordan Lee / coord with infra) - due: 2026-07-15" ,
- "A5: Decide on kernel-selection v2 production rollout (owner: Priya Raman) - due: 2026-07-15" ,
- "A6: Finalize console tracing SLO thresholds and post draft to #console-ops for sign-off (owner: Evelyn Chen) - due: 2026-07-14" ,
- "A7: File follow-up with SRE about audit log retention for tracing (owner: Jordan Lee) - due: 2026-07-17" ,

Follow-ups from last week:
- "F1: Marco to investigate replication lag in gpu-update-3 (status: investigating) - linked: JIRA RINF-1272" ,
- "F2: Priya to re-run A/B test with quantized weights (status: queued) - linked: PR #882" ,

Risks / open questions:
- If kernel-selection v2 increases variance on long-context, we risk customer impact on streaming generation SLOs. Need rollback plan and canary cutoff.
- Autoscale rollback may leave KV caches cold which will increase per-token latency; need to define acceptable transient penalty.

If time permits:
- Quick review of experiment to auto-select quantization profile per-route (2 min)

Misc links (bring to meeting):
- Perf dashboards (Grafana): https://grafana.redwood-inference/internal/d/serving-runtime/perf-overview
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood-inference/browse/RINF-1245 (kernel-selection variance)
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/882
- Slack thread (kernel v2 rollout): https://slack.redwood-inference/archives/C02ABC123/p169xxx
